final: SELECT t.tradekind, AVG(pair_stats.record_count) AS avg_record_count, AVG(pair_stats.share) AS avg_share, AVG(pair_stats.share - type_stats.avg_share) AS avg_excess_share FROM (SELECT ab.translink, tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY tr.tradekind) AS share FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.tradekind) AS pair_stats JOIN (SELECT trader_type, AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM (SELECT tr.tradekind AS trader_type, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY tr.tradekind) AS share FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.tradekind) GROUP BY trader_type) AS type_stats ON type_stats.trader_type = pair_stats.tradekind WHERE pair_stats.share > type_stats.avg_share GROUP BY t.tradekind
